basic_info.description: 1622A McAllister is a rare house-like TIC of incredible scale and proportion, measuring over 1600 square feet plus there is an additional 560SF of bonus area. The lower floor of a two-unit building for fast-track condo conversion, the home has new, wide plank oak floors, high ceilings and great details. The kitchen has been updated with quartz counters and stainless appliances and has an adjacent massive walkout deck. The garage level is cavernous, with abundant room for parking and storage for both units. The parking is currently tandem but could easily be made side-side by reengineering the center beam supports. In a great NOPA location near all the amenities of the Divisadero corridor, this wonderful home is not to be missed.
